==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I was being carried by a group of people. I felt like I was flying. It was incredible.

I was thrown into the ground. I felt this crushing pressure over my body. Then I felt my physical body move and became lucid.

The pressure was a collapsed building pinning me down. My lucidity gave me strength. I lifted the debris off my body like I was Hercules.
